Container.Name: Broadwave-Updater
Container.Overview: Optional. Keeps the Broadwave container on the newest release. It checks nightly at 03:30 and updates only containers that carry the Broadwave template's updater labels. It skips a night while a tuner is in use, a recording is running, or a recording starts within two hours, and tries again the next night. Install the Broadwave template first. This container has no web page.
Container.Description: Watchtower, limited to Broadwave. The Broadwave template labels its container so this updater can see it, and so Broadwave can say it is busy before an update. Leave "Only labeled containers" and "Busy check" on. Set TZ to the same value as Broadwave. The Docker socket is how the updater pulls the new image and recreates that one container.
Container.Requires: The Broadwave container, installed from the Broadwave template. That template carries the labels this updater reads. Do not point this at every container on the server.

Config.Name: Docker socket
Config.Description: Lets the updater pull the new image and recreate Broadwave.

Config.Name: TZ
Config.Description: Time zone for the nightly check, like America/Chicago. Use the same value as Broadwave.

Config.Name: Schedule
Config.Description: When to check: seconds, minutes, hours, day, month, weekday. The default is 03:30 every night.

Config.Name: Only labeled containers
Config.Description: Keep true, so the updater leaves every other container alone.

Config.Name: Busy check
Config.Description: Keep true, so Broadwave can say it is busy and skip a night.

Config.Name: Remove old images
Config.Description: Delete the previous Broadwave image after an update.
